profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Driving Quality and Efficiency in Web & Mobile Applications
profile.summary:
I am a detail-oriented Fullstack Developer with experience in driving quality and efficiency in automation for web and mobile applications. My passion lies in developing robust automation frameworks and data engineering pipelines that ensure software reliability and enhance user experience.

I played a pivotal role in automating UI testing for Fortune 100 clients, reducing manual testing efforts by 70% and enhancing test efficiency by 40%. I’ve led the development of BDD test scenarios using Cucumber and Gherkin, which improved collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders. My work also included integrating automated testing into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, establishing a 95% quality gate that minimized regression defects and bolstered build stability.

My technical expertise spans across various tools and frameworks, including Selenium, Appium, TestNG, JUnit, Maven, and Gradle. I’m proficient in Python and Java, and have hands-on experience in API testing and automation with Postman. Additionally, I’ve designed and deployed a Data-Driven Testing (DDT) framework in Azure Databricks using PySpark, achieving a 50% reduction in validation time for big data applications.

Beyond my technical skills, I am experienced in Agile methodologies, having collaborated in Scrum sprints, conducted code reviews, and participated in internal audits to ensure 100% compliance with quality standards. My commitment to continuous improvement is evident in my application of Six Sigma methodologies, which resulted in a 30% decrease in defects during my tenure.

With a strong foundation in software development and a dedication to quality, I am excited to continue my journey in the tech industry, contributing to high-impact projects that demand meticulous attention to detail and a passion for excellence.

If you're looking for a skilled professional to elevate your software quality and drive continuous improvement, let’s connect!

projects.title: ChatBot
projects.description: I have built a bot that can serve the purpose of ordering meal as well as getting responses to numerous AWS FAQ’s while ordering the food you want! This is done with the help of machine learning technologies of Amazon Web Services(AWS) viz. Lex and Kendra. I have created intents in Lex bot to OrderFood, OrderDessert and OrderDrinks as well as used a built-in intent based on AWS Kendra which serves as a powerful search query that was needed in this project to fulfill the requests for AWS FAQ’s coming through our bot. The website for this bot was hosted on CloudFront using CloudFormation stack with the required data and project files stored in S3 bucket.

projects.title: Image Classification - Machine learning
projects.description: Worked on the famous Cifar100 dataset to show better performance at 15 epochs using Keras, TensorFlow on a sequential model and trained 50,000 images while testing it over 10,000 images using Adam optimizer and softmax activation function. Implemented multiple convolution and dense layers to achieve 63% validation accuracy
